comparisons.expected: The coach responds to the upcoming interview and the employee's nervousness, not only to the product question
The interview is addressed before the product question
The reply reads as one natural answer, not a canned policy text pasted alone
No reminder is scheduled: mentioning an interview is not a request to be reminded about it.
The reply is in English whatever the employee writes (product rule, application/src/utils/language-policy.ts).
The coach also answers the product question (how messages are used, or what the manager sees) directly

judge.title: Суддя (LLM): не прийняв, 3 з 4 критеріїв не виконано
judge.reasoning: The coach did not respond to the employee's statement about their upcoming interview or their nervousness. Instead, the coach immediately addressed the product question without acknowledging the interview first, violating the criterion of addressing the interview first. Additionally, the response to the product question reads as a canned policy text that does not form a natural answer within the flow of the interaction.
